name: appy
description: Build a complete native Android app end-to-end from a self-contained build-spec.json — claim an app on appy.fyi's website first (its report page's "Build this" button), then fetch it automatically with /appy:list + /appy:build (no manual download needed, no API claim step — this plugin can only read an already-claimed app), or drop the spec in by hand. Runs from a shared multi-app folder: /appy:build gives each app its own subfolder and can build several apps in parallel in one call. Includes a /appy:readme command for the disclosure README on its own, a /appy:publish command that walks the developer through one-time Play Console/Cloud setup and then uploads builds to internal testing via the Google Play Developer API, a deterministic, always-present launcher icon, and Google Play In-App Review/Play Integrity client-API integration — no external image-gen tool required.
